URL: https://abcnews.com/International/major-wildfire-france-stabilized-contained-interior-minister/story?id=135123975
(ABC News; article dated 27 July 2026 — Nunez detail + Spain/weather context)

- Interior Minister Laurent Nunez: "As I speak, the fire is stabilized, but it has not been fully contained." He described the fire as having "a life of its own" and being "entirely unprecedented."
- Gironde fire: 104,000 acres burned (~4x Paris size); 240+ homes destroyed; ignited 22 July near Bordeaux.
- 220,000+ evacuated in France.
- Spain: Ávila Province fire 111,000 acres = Spain's largest on record; ~80,000 evacuated around Madrid and Ávila; +30,000 evacuated from Castellón Province.
- Spain death: a 79-year-old man died 24 July in Manises, northwest of Valencia.
- Weather: France temps ~95F (35C) Tuesday, higher Wednesday; Madrid region 100F+ (38C+) Tuesday with 18 mph gusts.
